frames.explanation: In the repository, open codes, python, and chapter_tree in turn to find this file; the full path is codes/python/chapter_tree/binary_tree_bfs.py. In general, locate the corresponding source file at codes/<language>/<chapter_directory>/<filename>. The book text shows the core algorithm snippet, whereas the repository file includes test cases that can be read and executed; the shared filename links the two.
